title: Assistant completion claim promoted as success
symptom: A task is recorded as successful even though later user feedback reports crashes, unresolved errors, missing options, or stale packages.
root_cause: Memory generation trusted the assistant's final summary or structural checks instead of independent evidence.
prevention: Use the evidence ladder.
Never promote assistant-claimed completion.
Mark structural-only results as tool-validated.
Search later messages and tester feedback before finalizing memory.

sources.note: User reported the Ohellno build completely crashed.
User reported a For Honor BFCO rebuild caused a game-load crash.

title: Cross-agent project duplication and stale-authority confusion
symptom: Several copies of the same mod exist under Claude, GPT, Grok, Downloads, or deployed folders, and an agent edits or packages the wrong lineage.
root_cause: Authority was inferred from folder name or timestamp without provenance and semantic comparison.
prevention: One mod, one owner root.
Locate all copies before editing.
Use CURRENT, changelog, version, hashes, and semantic diff to select authority.
Write an ownership note when a project moves.

sources.note: Build a Follower lineages became confused after moves between agent roots.
User explicitly requested no duplication between Claude and Grok roots.

title: Files written into deployed Skyrim locations
symptom: Test or duplicate ESPs appear in the game folder.
root_cause: Agent treated deployed Data as a writable workspace.
prevention: Author only in versioned work roots
Treat game Data and Vortex staging as read-only
required_validation: Check deployed Data for unexpected changed files

sources.note: User asked why two ESPs were put in the Skyrim folder.

title: Fix became an unwanted patch or overlay
symptom: The user asks to repair their mod, but the agent creates a separate patch.
root_cause: Agent prioritized minimal touch over the requested replacement release.
prevention: When the user owns the mod, repair the actual mod unless a patch is requested

sources.note: User required the final Ohellno mod, not another patch.
User required Oitsin itself to be fixed and ready to share.

title: Modernization removed intended content or installer choices
symptom: NPCs, locations, dialogue, variants, FOMOD choices, or dynamic distribution behavior disappear during cleanup.
root_cause: The agent equated fewer overrides with deleting features.
prevention: Create a feature/options preservation manifest.
Explain every removal.
Offer cleaned and content-preserving variants when both are useful.

sources.note: User objected to a modernization that may have nuked NPCs and tents.
For Honor rebuild lost its FOMOD and dynamic NPC intent.

title: Invalid FOMOD XML
symptom: Installer throws Sch_InvalidElementContentExpecting near the beginning of ModuleConfig.xml.
root_cause: XML was well-formed text but violated the FOMOD schema or element ordering.
prevention: Validate against the actual schema
Test with the intended installer
Inspect every branch

sources.note: Amazoness and Nymph Girls packages produced schema errors at line 4.

title: Working folder fixed but final ZIP stale
symptom: The final archive still contains the old ESP/config or omits recent changes.
root_cause: Packaging used the wrong staging root or occurred before the final changes.
prevention: Build archive last
Compare hashes between workspace and ZIP
Inspect archive inventory
required_validation: Open ZIP and verify exact files

sources.note: User suspected Oitsin FormID fix was not rezipped.

title: FOMOD options or full payload disappear during rebuild
symptom: The rebuilt version lacks installer variants or required payload.
root_cause: Agent rebuilt from a partial tree or treated optional branches as disposable.
prevention: Inventory prior release
Preserve branch matrix
Diff archive trees

sources.note: User reported the For Honor FOMOD was gone.

title: Unresolved references remain in plugin
symptom: xEdit reports Could not be resolved for keywords, associated items, or other references.
root_cause: Invalid local FormID, missing master, removed target record, or stale reference after rebuild.
prevention: Resolve every changed reference
Validate masters
Never invent replacement FormIDs

sources.note: Amazoness/Nymph races retained unresolved keyword references.
For Honor MGEF associated item remained unresolved.

title: Malformed VMAD or unsupported property encoding
symptom: xEdit reports expected byte counts, value type 255, or malformed script/property data.
root_cause: Hand-built or incorrectly copied VMAD structures did not match the actual binary format.
prevention: Use typed VMAD tooling
Preserve known-good bindings
Validate every property type
Verify VMAD string encoding, object format, property data order, and master/local FormID ownership against the exact plugin format.
Reload and inspect every script/property, not only VMAD byte length.

sources.note: Amazoness quests had malformed VMAD byte counts.
Oitsin retained unrecognized VMAD value type errors.
Ohellno/Oitsin failures involved extra nulls, zstring/wstring confusion, format/order errors, and wrong master-index ownership.
A later run still produced malformed VMAD after a claimed correction.

title: Invalid record/subrecord order
symptom: Plugin loader reports an unexpected or out-of-order subrecord such as VTYP in NPC_.
root_cause: Binary writer emitted subrecords from an incomplete or incorrect schema.
prevention: Typed record writer
Compare against known-good records
Deep-load changed record families

sources.note: Amazoness patch NPC_ records contained out-of-order VTYP.

title: Header or record-count mismatch
symptom: Creation Kit or plugin tools crash or reject a plugin because the header count does not match actual records.
root_cause: Writer updated records without recomputing header metadata.
prevention: Recompute metadata through typed tooling
Count records from final plugin

sources.note: Nymph Girls was reported with a header/record mismatch.

title: Eligible plugin shipped without intended ESL flag
symptom: A small compatibility patch remains full ESP despite intended light status.
root_cause: Flagging was omitted or the packaged plugin was stale.
prevention: Check eligibility and final packaged flags
Do not assume working copy equals ZIP

sources.note: Two Banter Conversation Fixes plugins repeatedly lacked the expected ESL flag.

title: Game-load crash after plugin rebuild
symptom: Game crashes immediately on load, sometimes without a crash log, after an AI rebuild.
root_cause: Structurally plausible plugin changes were runtime-invalid.
prevention: Stop and revert to last known-good.
Binary/semantic diff the smallest changed set.
Do not stack further changes before isolating the crash.

sources.note: Ohellno build crashed.
For Honor build crashed on game load.
Build a Follower update was followed by a crash report.

title: MCM Helper JSON passes casual inspection but UI is invalid
symptom: MCM displays no config, invalid button, or an empty main page.
root_cause: Unsupported option type or incomplete page/binding structure.
prevention: Validate exact installed MCM Helper schema
Test page rendering and bindings

sources.note: Ohellno/Oitsin tester feedback reported invalid button and missing page.

title: Large runtime-distribution output becomes malformed or semantically broad
symptom: Thousands of lines are inconsistently formatted, duplicated, contradictory, or affect unintended NPCs.
root_cause: One-shot generation without parser, stable ordering, target expansion, or chunk review.
prevention: Generate deterministic chunks.
Parse every row.
Resolve every plugin/FormID.
Audit duplicates, contradictions, and expanded targets.

sources.note: User reports Grok rushes and creates weirdly formatted large SPID mods.

title: Compiled against stale or fake dependency API
symptom: Scripts compile but report dependency version errors or fail at runtime.
root_cause: Compile-only stubs or remembered framework APIs replaced the real installed parent sources.
prevention: Compile against actual installed parents
Verify runtime DLL/API contract
Do not ship stubs

sources.note: Oitsin required correction of OStim API/version integration.
Ohellno displayed an incorrect OStim update requirement before later crash work.
CommonLib expressions compiled at source level but failed to link because the pinned library lacked the required template instantiations.

title: Preset application produces blue head or head/body mismatch
symptom: A newly created follower has a blue/purple head, mismatched skin tone, wrong appearance, or tattoos missing.
root_cause: The full cause is project-specific; observed risk areas include applying before actor 3D is ready, incomplete head/tint export, and interactions with body/normal-map systems.
prevention: Do not guess one universal cause.
Test apply-before-summon and summon-before-apply.
Wait for actor 3D when the API requires it.
Verify head/tint, body, tattoos, sex, race, and voice together.

sources.note: StampFollowers tester reported blue face and wrong preset ordering behavior.
Build a Follower feedback described repeatable tint mismatch and tattoo issues.

title: Reset/dismiss logic affects the player instead of follower
symptom: Reset or dismiss teleports the player into a temporary cell.
root_cause: Actor reference or MoveTo target was applied to the wrong participant.
prevention: Assert the target actor
Test player location before/after every reset path

sources.note: User reported reset/dismiss could trap the player in a temp cell.

title: Custom scene control bypasses OStim timing and transitions
symptom: Scenes skip foreplay, transition too quickly, glitch, or climax immediately while built-in Auto Mode works.
root_cause: Addon manually drives animation/pace/orgasm state without respecting installed OStim configuration and lifecycle.
prevention: Use documented lifecycle/API
Delegate timing to OStim where possible
Test against built-in Auto Mode

sources.note: Tester reports described ignored duration/foreplay and immediate climax/glitching.

title: Cross-application handoff omits attachments or filesystem reality
symptom: A receiving agent has a conversation summary but not the referenced archives, attachments, deployed state, or exact final snapshot.
root_cause: Conversation context was treated as a transferable filesystem and evidence bundle.
prevention: Create a handoff manifest with exact paths, hashes, active version, attachments, and missing inputs.
Verify every referenced file exists before analysis or implementation.
Label summaries as narrative context, not proof of file contents or validation.

sources.note: Referenced ChatGPT attachments were not present in the Codex workspace.
Expected workspace/path context did not resolve as assumed.

title: Active installed build is newer or different than the workspace lineage
symptom: An agent audits or rebuilds an older workspace/archive while the actually installed mod contains a newer or materially different version.
root_cause: Authority was chosen from an agent folder or archive instead of comparing CURRENT, deployed inventory, version files, and semantic content.
prevention: Inventory owner roots, archives, and the active installed/deployed build before selecting authority.
Use the installed build as read-only evidence when it is newer, then recover its provenance into a new owner snapshot.
Record why one lineage was selected and what differs from the others.

sources.note: Installed Oitsin 1.7 was newer than the available workspace and archive versions.

title: Moved workspace keeps stale absolute build caches and paths
symptom: Configure or build commands point to an old owner root, stale source tree, or deleted location after a project move or version snapshot.
root_cause: Generated caches and absolute paths were copied with the source snapshot and trusted without reconfiguration.
prevention: Treat build directories and tool caches as disposable generated output.
Reconfigure from a clean build directory after a move or version copy.
Search logs and cache files for paths outside the active snapshot.
required_validation: Build log confirms active source root

sources.note: Native project build state retained stale path assumptions.
CMake cache paths required clean regeneration after workspace changes.

title: Review or audit changes were never compiled against the exact local dependencies
symptom: A code review appears correct, but the changed tree fails to compile or link against the project’s pinned CommonLib, parent sources, or SDK.
root_cause: Review stopped at source reasoning and did not run the exact project build.
prevention: A reviewer that proposes code must either compile it or label it UNBUILT.
Build against the project’s exact dependency checkout and lock files.
Do not assume a template instantiation or API is available because a header permits the expression.
required_validation: Build command and exit code recorded

sources.note: An audit reintroduced CommonLib linker failures for unavailable template instantiations until the exact project was compiled.

title: Test harness layout masks runtime dependency and search-path behavior
symptom: A DLL works in a same-directory harness but fails in the game because dependencies resolve from a different root or loader layout.
root_cause: The test environment did not mirror the real executable root, plugin path, and dependency search behavior.
prevention: Build a runtime-shaped harness with a fake game root and the real relative plugin path.
Test dependency resolution from the same directories used by the game.
Inspect imports and load failures in the packaged layout.

sources.note: A same-directory DirectStorage harness hid that dstoragecore.dll was searched from the game root.

title: Building the entire dependency tree does not validate the target mod
symptom: A broad compile produces unrelated dependency errors or passes without actually compiling the target scripts and bindings.
root_cause: The validation surface was not isolated to the mod’s real sources and exact parents.
prevention: Compile the smallest complete target surface with real parent sources.
Separate dependency health from target-mod validation.
Record which files were compiled and which were excluded.

sources.note: Compiling an entire OStim tree produced unrelated errors and did not validate Ohellno until the target surface was isolated.

title: Unsafe loader-lock work performed inside DllMain
symptom: The plugin performs settings I/O, logging, API resolution, hook installation, UI, or device enumeration during DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH and crashes or deadlocks unpredictably.
root_cause: Initialization work that can allocate, load libraries, lock, invoke COM/UI, or touch the filesystem was run under the Windows loader lock.
prevention: Keep DllMain minimal and defer work to the loader/framework initialization callback.
Avoid MessageBox, SetupAPI, filesystem, logging setup, and dynamic loading under loader lock.
Test clean process startup and failure paths.

sources.note: NextGen Disk Cache moved heavy initialization out of DllMain after identifying unsafe loader-lock operations.

title: Hook scope, stored references, or side effects outlive their valid context
symptom: A broad hook captures unintended handles or a stored game reference becomes invalid during cell/world transitions, causing crashes or erratic behavior.
root_cause: The implementation did not prove ownership, lifetime, thread context, or target scope before using the value later.
prevention: Gate hooks to the exact intended objects and operations.
Snapshot stable handles or IDs before side effects and revalidate before use.
Avoid APIs whose internal world/cell pointers can dangle during transitions.
Test transitions, dialogue, loading, and competing systems.

sources.note: NPC pathing crashed through an unsafe range traversal during world/cell transitions and showed replay side effects on invalid contexts.
Broad DirectStorage hook scope was narrowed to intended handles.

title: Structurally valid feature is player-invisible or semantically ineffective
symptom: Files, records, and scripts validate, but the intended behavior is too weak, unreachable, or invisible in representative gameplay.
root_cause: Validation checked structure and loadability without measuring player-visible outcomes in the intended environments.
prevention: Define observable acceptance tests before implementation.
Test representative towns, wilderness, interiors, weather, schedules, and edge cases.
Do not call a bootstrap, flat approximation, or technically loaded record a complete feature.

sources.note: Vivid Routines was structurally valid while wilderness behavior remained visually inert.
A flat RMAOS bootstrap was initially described more broadly than the actual PBR result.

title: Broad actor, package, faction, or record selectors hit quests, scenes, followers, or creatures
symptom: A generic routine, teleport, distribution, or behavior package displaces scene actors, interrupts followers, or applies human-only behavior to creatures.
root_cause: Selector breadth and package priority were inferred from record type or faction membership without explicit exclusions and lifecycle tests.
prevention: Add explicit quest/scene/follower/creature exclusions supported by the exact framework.
Remember that creature actors can still be NPC_ records.
Test package priority against stage-conditioned and framework-owned packages.

sources.note: Vivid Routines packages displaced quest/scene actors, interrupted followers, and faction-only SPID lines leaked to creatures.

title: Framework condition, field grammar, or value type was guessed
symptom: A configuration parses incorrectly, throws conversion errors, silently matches nothing, or tests the wrong semantic property.
root_cause: A plausible-looking condition, quoted token, numeric expression, or helper function was used without verifying the exact version’s grammar and meaning.
prevention: Validate every field type and token against the installed framework parser or source.
Test one minimal known-good line before bulk generation.
Do not infer presence checks from functions that actually read keyword data or another property.

sources.note: GetKeywordDataForCurrentLocation was initially treated as a keyword-presence test although it reads keyword DATA.
SkyPatcher baseCost=*1.75 reached integer conversion logic and failed with invalid_argument/stoi.
Quoted KID plugin text was interpreted literally and broke the rule.

title: Spatial anchor or nearest-reference search crosses invalid boundaries
symptom: Actors stand at doors, travel to a distant or wrong-worldspace reference, or replay movement from an invalid distance.
root_cause: The implementation used load doors or unrestricted nearest-reference searches instead of validated XMarkers, worldspace filters, and distance gates.
prevention: Use reference types intended as behavior anchors.
Filter by worldspace/cell and maximum distance.
Validate the anchor remains loaded and appropriate before replay or teleport.

sources.note: Vivid Routines used load-door anchors and a nearest search that crossed to Japhet’s Folly.

title: Dependency or asset detection uses substrings, loose-file checks, or arbitrary profile selection
symptom: The wrong compatibility mode is selected, an unrelated plugin name triggers a match, or required voice/face assets are reported missing despite being archived.
root_cause: Detection used filename substrings, loose-file existence, timestamp-selected profiles, or assumed texture slots instead of exact plugin sets and archive-aware resolution.
prevention: Match exact plugin filenames and normalized dependency IDs.
Inspect BSA/BA2 archives and mod-manager virtual/deployed state.
Choose the active profile from its enabled plugin set, not arbitrary timestamps.
Verify asset slot semantics with the exact record/mesh format.

sources.note: Follower Forge exposed substring false matches, BSA-hidden voice assets, profile selection errors, hardlink deployment behavior, and a nonzero face-tint texture slot.

title: Encoding, BOM, newline, or version-specific filename drift breaks a valid-looking file
symptom: The file looks readable but the game/framework ignores it, misparses it, or fails because its encoding, line endings, or filename contract changed.
root_cause: A rewrite normalized bytes or reused an older filename without preserving the exact consumer contract.
prevention: Detect and preserve original encoding, BOM, and newline style unless migration is verified.
Validate translation/config encodings with the actual consumer.
Resolve the filename from the installed framework version, not an old guide.

sources.note: Grass cache configuration required UTF-8 BOM and CRLF, and the active filename differed from older guidance.
Nemesis Combat AI output included incorrect translation encoding.

title: SEQ file emitted as text, ASCII, or an invented header
symptom: Start-enabled quest behavior does not initialize because the SEQ payload is not the canonical binary format expected by the game/toolchain.
root_cause: The format was guessed from a name or fabricated header instead of verified against a known-good binary or official tool output.
prevention: Treat SEQ as a binary artifact.
Compare bytes and record ordering against known-good output.
Never invent a SEQS header or write FormIDs as text.

sources.note: Nemesis Combat AI generated an ASCII .seq instead of the expected binary payload.
For Honor work identified an invented SEQS header; the canonical test artifact was raw binary u32 data.

title: Inherited defects and AI-introduced regressions are conflated
symptom: A rebuild is blamed for every defect, or an original defect is preserved and later reported as newly fixed without evidence.
root_cause: No immutable known-good/original baseline and per-version defect matrix was maintained.
prevention: Record original known defects before editing.
Diff original, parent, active, and final artifacts separately.
Label each defect inherited, fixed, newly introduced, or unverified.

sources.note: For Honor analysis required separating original defects from AI-introduced OAR/SEQ regressions.

title: Release metadata, version strings, or development artifacts drift across the package
symptom: The DLL, manifest, README, installer, archive name, logs, or changelog report different versions, or release ZIPs contain PDBs/caches not intended for users.
root_cause: Version declarations and release inventory were scattered and not generated or audited together.
prevention: Maintain a single version source where practical.
Audit every public version string before packaging.
Use an explicit release allowlist and separate symbol/developer archives.

sources.note: NextGen Disk Cache carried version text across many files and required synchronized release metadata.

title: Documentation or MCM claims a feature that the implementation does not contain
symptom: Descriptions promise thresholds, heroes, systems, compatibility, or visual quality absent from the shipped code and data.
root_cause: Release copy was derived from intent or previous prose rather than an inventory of implemented and validated behavior.
prevention: Trace every public claim to code, data, configuration, and a validation result.
Remove or label planned and experimental behavior.
Generate release notes from the final diff and feature matrix.

sources.note: For Honor descriptions and MCM text referred to hero/threshold behavior that was not implemented.
PBR output scope was initially overstated relative to the flat bootstrap result.

title: A dynamic appearance system re-applies after a transient follower fix
symptom: Head/body normals, tint, skin, or body shape briefly match and then change again after 3D load, framework update, save reload, or outfit/body distribution.
root_cause: The fix targeted the base actor once while a dynamic appearance system retained ownership and re-applied later.
prevention: Identify every system that owns body, skin, normals, tint, and preset application.
Apply or synchronize at the correct actor-3D and framework lifecycle point.
Test summon order, save reload, reset, outfit change, and framework reapplication.

sources.note: Follower Forge debugging showed asset-slot and deployment complexity requiring runtime-aware appearance ownership checks.

title: Extended FormID range without Game Master first
symptom: An ESL-flagged module uses a new local FormID below 0x800 without Skyrim.esm as first master.
root_cause: Extended 1.71 allocation was treated as only a header/range change.
prevention: Use HEDR 1.71 for extended local IDs 0x001-0xFFF
List Skyrim.esm as first master whenever the extended range is actually used
Run the V4 plugin header audit

title: Dependent module incompatible with 1.71 master
symptom: A dependent plugin uses HEDR 1.70 while relying on a 1.71 master or its extended records.
root_cause: Only the child plugin header was checked.
prevention: Inspect master headers
Promote dependent output to 1.71 when required
Declare runtime/backport requirements

title: Incomplete or misordered transitive master chain
symptom: A direct master requires an earlier master that is absent or appears after it.
root_cause: Master cleaning or generation considered only direct record references.
prevention: Preserve complete up-chain masters
Validate master order against each master header
Do not remove masters by superficial scan

title: Current KID type labels replaced with record signatures
symptom: Generated KID uses WEAP/ARMO/MGEF as the type field instead of current human-readable KID type labels.
root_cause: KID ordinary type field was modeled from record signatures or left blank instead of using the parser's exact human-readable type array.
prevention: Use exact human-readable KID type labels
Reject record signatures in ordinary type field
Reject blank ordinary type field
Handle KID ExclusiveGroup as separate grammar

title: Current SPID trait grammar rewritten incorrectly
symptom: SPID TraitFilters are rewritten from slash-delimited tokens to comma-delimited text, silently dropping intended trait checks.
root_cause: Historical prose or whole-line delimiter counting overrode the SPID 7.3.x field-specific parser.
prevention: Split and validate the fifth SPID value field only
Use `/` between trait tokens such as `F/-T` or `-C/-D`
Do not flag commas in documented StringFilters, FormFilters, or LevelFilters
Pin parser commit e5ef32b99ecb277778644f4deae0ac04851ca614

title: SkyPatcher file or operation silently ignored
symptom: Configuration is in the root rather than a category, or uses an invented operation such as itemsRemove.
root_cause: Directory placement and installed-version operations were guessed.
prevention: Use a supported category directory
Verify each key against installed docs/source
Run framework linter

title: Competing BOS dialects shipped
symptom: The active library presents both sectioned pipe syntax and Base = Swap as equivalent.
root_cause: Historical examples were merged without version resolution.
prevention: Use skyrim-base-object-swapper as sole syntax owner
Verify installed BOS version
Run framework linter

title: Legacy SKI_ConfigBase selected for a new menu without reason
symptom: A new mod receives boilerplate legacy MCM code instead of current MCM Helper architecture.
root_cause: Legacy examples were treated as the default.
prevention: Default new work to MCM Helper
Keep SKI_ConfigBase for legacy maintenance
Plan migration before changing existing menus

title: Optional trailing SPID or KID fields rejected as malformed
symptom: A valid short SPID or KID entry is rejected merely because trailing optional fields were omitted.
root_cause: A validator confused the maximum number of field positions with an exact required count.
prevention: SPID: accept 1-7 value sections and pad omitted trailing positions for analysis
KID: accept 2-5 value sections and pad omitted trailing positions for analysis
Require pipes only for skipped interior positions

title: Valid BOS Transforms or Properties section rejected
symptom: A current `_SWAP.ini` using `[Transforms]` or `[Properties]` is flagged as invalid.
root_cause: The linter knew only `[Forms]` and `[References]` and treated current direct-override sections as unknown.
prevention: Allow current Forms, References, Transforms, and Properties section families
Validate field count according to section family
Version-gate property/transform tokens
required_validation: Positive fixtures for all four section families

title: Guide or skill outranks the actual framework parser
symptom: Working syntax is rewritten to satisfy stale prose, producing silent no-ops.
root_cause: The authority order placed a bundled skill or historical plan above the exact installed parser/source.
prevention: Exact installed parser and matching upstream source outrank skills
Pin source version and commit in FRAMEWORK-SOURCE-LOCK.json
Run framework truth-lock self-tests before release
required_validation: Dedicated skill agrees with source lock

title: Unsupported SPID distribution key discards an entire generated feature family
symptom: SPID logs thousands of `Unsupported form type Weapon` messages and accepts none of the intended weapon/staff rows.
root_cause: The generator mapped the WEAP record signature or plain-language object class to a nonexistent `Weapon` SPID key.
prevention: Validate every distribution key against the exact SPID parser whitelist
Use `Item` or intentional generic `Form` for weapons and staves
Require one representative form from every source plugin to resolve before bulk output
required_validation: Known-positive staff appears on an intended NPC

title: Malformed SPID LevelFilters range blamed on valid traits or chance
symptom: A row with `65/|-C/-D||18!` fails with numeric conversion error.
root_cause: The LevelFilters field contains an empty maximum endpoint. `-D` and deterministic `18!` are valid in their own fields.
prevention: Parse the row into seven field positions before diagnosing
Require both endpoints of actor-level ranges
Keep TraitFilters slash-delimited and Chance numeric with optional `!`
required_validation: Runtime log no longer reports numeric parse failure

title: One SPID row contains both field-count and trait/intent defects
symptom: An eight-section row is fixed by deleting one pipe but remains semantically or syntactically wrong.
root_cause: The repair addressed only the parser's first reported failure and did not re-map all fields or compare the row to filename/feature intent.
prevention: Continue field-aware validation after the first error
Use `/` inside TraitFilters
Treat filename/feature labels such as MaleOnly versus `F` as an intent conflict requiring confirmation

title: Hook target outside expected executable section is over-attributed
symptom: A feature aborts because its candidate target is outside `SkyrimSE.exe` `.text`, and another DLL is named as culprit without address-ownership proof.
root_cause: A valid safety check was converted into an unsupported causal conclusion.
prevention: Resolve candidate pointer to owning module
Log runtime, relocation/vtable index, section bounds, permissions, and bytes
Test feature toggles and exact dependency layout before blaming another plugin
required_validation: Owner module identified or cause left unresolved
Feature status documented separately from whole-plugin status

title: Community Shaders preset overrides a feature whose descriptor did not load
symptom: The log says a feature INI failed to load and was disabled, while a preset later reports applying an override for that feature.
root_cause: The feature descriptor is absent, mismatched, or losing deployment; the override was mistaken for successful feature activation.
prevention: Inspect `Data\Shaders\Features\<ShortName>.ini` for the exact release
Check feature/core status and deployed winner
Verify preset requirements and loaded-feature log

title: Missing HKX is treated as generic behavior-generator output
symptom: A custom creature or character graph references animations that are absent and the only recommendation is to rerun a generator.
root_cause: Missing source assets, stale graph references, and generated behavior output were not classified separately.
prevention: Resolve each path to owning graph/mod/archive
Check loose and archive inventories
Regenerate only when the chosen generator owns the missing output
Never claim APoseFix creates missing animations
required_validation: Every referenced HKX resolves or stale reference is removed

title: Alphabetical BOS winner is mistaken for semantically correct patch
symptom: A logged winner is accepted or reversed by filename alone without checking the affected reference and conditions.
root_cause: Mechanical conflict resolution was treated as compatibility reasoning.
prevention: Resolve reference, cell/worldspace, qualifiers, and mod combination
Audit duplicate source identities across all `_SWAP.ini` files
Create a combined/narrow patch when both inputs are relevant
required_validation: Intended transform tested on actual reference

title: Whitespace splits a BOS transform invocation
symptom: BOS fails to process later numeric fragments from `rotR(x, y, z)`.
root_cause: Spaces inside a function's argument list caused the locked parser grammar to tokenize the invocation incorrectly.
prevention: Emit contiguous transform functions
Run balanced-parenthesis and field-aware BOS linter
Generate transforms rather than hand-formatting bulk rows
required_validation: General linter detects exact live whitespace shape
Dedicated BOS auditor detects exact live whitespace shape

title: CDF wildcard-like add strings do not resolve and skip the change
symptom: Rules report invalid add data for strings such as `*Claw` or `*Katana`, leaving merchant additions inactive.
root_cause: FLM-like or conceptual wildcard syntax was used where CDF resolves each add string as one exact form.
prevention: Generate exact EditorID or FormID~Plugin entries from a typed manifest
Do not import FLM `*FormList` syntax into CDF JSON
Fail when any required add element is unresolved
required_validation: Every add form resolves in deployed manifest

title: Mod-manager bookkeeping file reaches a runtime configuration scanner
symptom: JContainers, TNG, or another plugin attempts to parse `__folder_managed_by_vortex` or manager sidecars.
root_cause: Deployment bookkeeping leaked into a directory scanned as runtime configuration.
prevention: Exclude manager markers and sidecars from source/release trees
Fix the owning staging package and redeploy
Do not patch the live Data directory as the permanent solution
required_validation: Runtime scanner no longer sees marker

title: Unresolved runtime target is not classified by dependency scope
symptom: Hundreds of missing plugins, keywords, FormIDs, or EditorIDs are either called harmless wholesale or deleted wholesale.
root_cause: Hard, conditional, optional, stale, and typo/mismatch cases were collapsed into one category.
prevention: Map each config to its owner and feature
Declare hard/conditional/optional requirements
Retain correctly guarded optional integrations
Remove or repair dead rows in owning source
required_validation: Required features have nonzero resolved targets

title: Validator disagreement is treated as proof the shipping config is broken
symptom: A runtime-accepted or parser-valid config is rewritten solely because an offline linter reports failure.
root_cause: The validator was treated as supreme authority instead of evidence subject to parser and runtime reconciliation.
prevention: Do not rewrite a config solely to satisfy a linter
Compare exact parser/version and runtime log
Quarantine and repair a contradicted validator
Publication is evidence, not proof
required_validation: Production runtime log or known-positive behavior

title: Claimed regression fixture does not execute the production validator path
symptom: Documentation says a failure shape is covered, but the CLI/auditor used on real files remains silent.
root_cause: A helper or synthetic assertion was tested while the production entry point omitted the check.
prevention: Run production entry points on production-shaped fixtures
Use exact live failure lines where available
Fail truth lock when the actual auditor misses the fixture

title: Special SPID keys are rejected by a flat ordinary-key allowlist
symptom: Valid ExclusiveGroup, DeathItem, or linked rows are flagged unsupported by the offline validator.
root_cause: Validator modeled only RECORD type names and ignored the pre-parsers for exclusive, linked, and on-death distribution.
prevention: Classify SPID key families before field validation
Apply two-, four-, or seven-field grammar by family
Source-lock pre-parser order

title: Offline framework linter parses trailing INI comments as field data
symptom: Rows accepted by the runtime are rejected offline because `; explanation` is included in Chance, type, or filter text.
root_cause: Validator split raw source lines instead of normalizing the INI parser comment behavior.
prevention: Strip unquoted trailing semicolon comments before field parsing
Retain original line numbers for diagnostics
Test runtime-shaped commented rows
